title: Friday Plans

lines.en: Hey James, it's finally Friday! Any plans for the weekend?
lines.zh: 嘿 James，終於星期五了！週末有什麼計畫嗎？

lines.en: Not really. I'm a bit worn out after this week, to be honest.
lines.zh: 其實沒有。老實說，這週過完我有點累壞了。

lines.en: I know what you mean. That deadline on Wednesday was crazy.
lines.zh: 我懂你的意思。星期三那個截止期限真的很誇張。

lines.en: Yeah. I stayed at the office until nine o'clock two nights in a row.
lines.zh: 對啊。我連續兩個晚上待在公司到九點。

lines.en: Oh no. So you probably just want to rest, right?
lines.zh: 天啊。所以你大概只想休息，對吧？

lines.en: Saturday, definitely. I'm thinking of sleeping in and doing nothing at all.
lines.zh: 星期六絕對是。我在想要睡到自然醒，什麼都不做。

lines.en: That sounds nice. I wish I could do that.
lines.zh: 聽起來真好。真希望我也可以這樣。

lines.en: Why? What are you doing this weekend?
lines.zh: 為什麼？你這個週末要做什麼？

lines.en: My sister is visiting from Taichung. We haven't seen each other since summer.
lines.zh: 我妹妹要從台中來找我。我們從夏天之後就沒見過面了。

lines.en: Oh, that's great! You must have a lot to catch up on.
lines.zh: 喔，太好了！你們一定有很多近況要聊。

lines.en: We do. We talk on the phone, but it's not the same.
lines.zh: 是啊。我們會講電話，但感覺不一樣。

lines.en: So what are you two going to do?
lines.zh: 那你們兩個要做什麼？

lines.en: I'm thinking of taking her to the night market on Saturday evening.
lines.zh: 我在想星期六晚上帶她去逛夜市。

lines.en: Good idea. Which one?
lines.zh: 好主意。哪一個夜市？

lines.en: Probably the one near the train station. The food there is really good.
lines.zh: 大概是火車站附近那個。那裡的東西很好吃。

lines.en: I've been there once. The fried chicken was amazing.
lines.zh: 我去過一次。那裡的炸雞超棒。

lines.en: Right? And on Sunday, we might go hiking if the weather is nice.
lines.zh: 對吧？然後星期天如果天氣好，我們可能會去爬山。

lines.en: Have you checked the weather forecast?
lines.zh: 你看過天氣預報了嗎？

lines.en: Not yet. I hope it doesn't rain again. Last weekend it rained all day.
lines.zh: 還沒。希望不要又下雨。上個週末下了一整天。

lines.en: Yeah, I remember. I had to cancel my plans too.
lines.zh: 對，我記得。我也只好取消我的計畫。

lines.en: What were you going to do?
lines.zh: 你原本要做什麼？

lines.en: A few friends and I wanted to get together for a barbecue.
lines.zh: 我跟幾個朋友本來想聚一聚烤肉。

lines.en: Oh, that's too bad. Did you reschedule it?
lines.zh: 喔，真可惜。你們有改期嗎？

lines.en: We did. Actually, it's on Sunday afternoon now.
lines.zh: 有啊。其實現在改到星期天下午。

lines.en: Wait, so you do have plans this weekend!
lines.zh: 等等，所以你這週末明明就有計畫嘛！

lines.en: Ha, I guess you're right. I forgot about that.
lines.zh: 哈，好像是耶。我忘了這件事。

lines.en: Where is the barbecue?
lines.zh: 烤肉在哪裡？

lines.en: At my friend's place. He has a small garden on the roof.
lines.zh: 在我朋友家。他在屋頂有一個小花園。

lines.en: A rooftop barbecue? That sounds like fun.
lines.zh: 屋頂烤肉？聽起來很好玩。

lines.en: It usually is. Hey, if you and your sister are free, you could join us.
lines.zh: 通常都很好玩。欸，如果你跟你妹妹有空，可以一起來。

lines.en: Really? Are you sure your friends won't mind?
lines.zh: 真的嗎？你確定你朋友不會介意？

lines.en: Not at all. The more, the merrier. Just bring something to drink.
lines.zh: 完全不會。人越多越好玩。帶點喝的來就好。

lines.en: That's so kind of you. Let me ask my sister first.
lines.zh: 你人真好。我先問一下我妹妹。

lines.en: Sure. No rush. Just send me a message by Saturday night.
lines.zh: 好啊。不急。星期六晚上之前傳個訊息給我就好。

lines.en: OK, I will. But what about hiking?
lines.zh: 好，我會的。那爬山怎麼辦？

lines.en: You can hike in the morning and come to the barbecue later. It starts at three.
lines.zh: 你們可以早上去爬山，之後再來烤肉。三點開始。

lines.en: That could work. We usually finish hiking before lunch.
lines.zh: 這樣可以。我們通常午餐前就爬完了。

lines.en: Perfect. Then it sounds like a plan.
lines.zh: 太好了。那就這麼說定了。

lines.en: Great. Thanks, James. Now I'm really looking forward to the weekend.
lines.zh: 太好了。謝啦，James。現在我真的很期待週末了。

lines.en: Me too. Now we just need to finish this report before five.
lines.zh: 我也是。現在我們只要在五點前把這份報告做完就好。

lines.en: Right. Back to work, then!
lines.zh: 對。那就回去工作吧！

options: He worked late because of a deadline.
quiz.why: James 說他連續兩晚在公司待到九點，因為星期三有截止期限。

quiz.q: Who is visiting Emma this weekend?
quiz.why: My sister is visiting from Taichung.

quiz.q: What time does the barbecue start?

words.ex1: I'm a bit worn out after this week, to be honest.
words.ex2: After the customer audit, the whole team was worn out.
words.ex2zh: 客戶稽核結束後，整個團隊都累壞了。

words.ex1: You must have a lot to catch up on.
words.ex2: I need to catch up on my emails after the business trip.
words.ex2zh: 出差回來我得把信補看完。

words.ex1: A few friends and I wanted to get together for a barbecue.
words.ex2: The QA team gets together every Monday to review last week's issues.
words.ex2zh: 品保團隊每週一聚在一起檢討上週的問題。

words.ex1: That deadline on Wednesday was crazy.
words.ex2: The deadline for the 8D report is this Friday.
words.ex2zh: 8D 報告的截止期限是這週五。

words.ex1: Oh, that's too bad. Did you reschedule it?
words.ex2: Can we reschedule the meeting to Tuesday morning?
words.ex2zh: 我們可以把會議改到星期二早上嗎？

speaking.patternZh: 我在想要……（說還沒完全決定的計畫）
speaking.task: 用 I'm thinking of... 說說你這個週末想做什麼，再加一句原因（用 because）。
speaking.example: I'm thinking of going to Daxi Old Street this weekend because I want to try some local food.

part2.q: When is the deadline for the quality report?
part2.why: 問 When（什麼時候），要回答時間。C 用了 reported 跟 report 發音很像，是多益常見的陷阱。
part2.zh: 品質報告的截止期限是什麼時候？

part2.q: Who's going to visit the customer next week?
part2.why: 問 Who（誰），要回答人。B 回答的是時間。
問 Why（為什麼），最常見的回答是 Because...。

part2.q: Could we reschedule the meeting to Monday?
part2.why: 這是請求，回答「可以／不行」最自然。C 的 met 跟 meeting 發音像，是陷阱。
part2.zh: 我們可以把會議改到星期一嗎？

part2.q: Have you checked the inspection results yet?
opts: Not yet. I'll do it after lunch.
part2.why: 問「做了沒」，回答 Not yet / Yes, I have。C 重複了 check 這個字，是陷阱。

reorder.zh: 我在想要睡到自然醒，什麼都不做。
我在想星期六晚上帶她去逛夜市。
我在想跟主管請下週一天假。

scene: Emma 和 James 在辦公室聊週末。
